## Column1 {width = "35%"}

```{r, loadpackages}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(gt)
library(tidygeocoder)
```

```{r, getdata}
#Define ebird API key.
api_key <- Sys.getenv("api_key")

# Define today's date.
today <- Sys.Date()
current_year <- format(today, "%Y")
current_month <- format(today, "%m")
current_day <- format(today, "%d")

# Define URL.
url <- sprintf("https://api.ebird.org/v2/data/obs/US-MI/historic/%s/%s/%s", current_year, current_month, current_day)

#API Call
species_data <- request(url) |> 
  req_headers(
    `X-eBirdApiToken` = api_key,
  ) |> 
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_json()
  

# Convert to tibble
species_data_df <- map_dfr(species_data, ~ as_tibble(.x))
```

```{r, obtaincity}

# Reverse geocode to obtain the city from the latitude/longitude coordinates.
loc_city <- species_data_df |> 
  reverse_geocode(lat = lat, long = lng, method = 'arcgis', 
                  address = address, full_results = TRUE) |>
  select(locId, City) |>
  group_by(locId) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r, obtaincounty}

# Reverse geocode to obtain the county from the latitude/longitude coordinates.
loc_county <- species_data_df |> 
  reverse_geocode(lat = lat, long = lng, method = 'arcgis', 
                  address = address, full_results = TRUE) |>
  select(locId, Subregion) |>
  group_by(locId) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r, combinetibbles}

# Combine the recent observations with the city and county data.

species_data_df <- left_join(species_data_df, loc_city, by = "locId")
species_data_df <- left_join(species_data_df, loc_county, by = "locId")
```


## Column2 {width = "65%"}
### Row {.row1}

```{r, sendtoojs}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

# The R tibble must be passed to Observable JavaScript before it can be accessed in
# an OJS cell.
ojs_define(species_data_ojs = species_data_df)
```

```{ojs, createSpeciesDropdown}
//| expandable: false

// Transpose the data to make it usable in ojs.
species_data_transposed = transpose(species_data_ojs)

// Create a dropdown menu of the species name.
viewof speciesNameDropdown = Inputs.select(
  Array.from(new Set(species_data_transposed.map(d => d.comName))),
  {
    label: "Choose a species",
    unique: true, // Only include each location once.
    sort: true // Sort the options alphabetically.
    }
)
```
